profile.name: Melissa Holyoak

roles.title: United States Attorney for the District of Utah

profile.description: United States Attorney for the District of Utah, with earlier FTC statements on AI markets and companions.

web.named_query: ("Stephen Weiss" OR "Melissa Holyoak") AI artificial intelligence superintelligence policy statements

summary.text: In January 2025 remarks, Holyoak said AI has potential to benefit consumers and make American businesses more effective, and that the FTC should act circumspectly, promote competition and innovation, and avoid unclear regulations or misguided enforcement actions. In a September 2025 statement, she said AI could be a momentous driver of innovation and economic growth, and that the FTC is committed to giving AI the ability to develop while meeting its mandate to ensure competitive markets and protect consumers from unlawful conduct. She also expressed concern about reports that AI chatbots can engage in alarming interactions with young users and that companies offering generative AI companion chatbots might have been warned by their own employees about insufficient protections for young users.

statements.text: Artificial intelligence has the prospect of being a momentous driver of innovation and economic growth in the coming years.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak

statements.text: I have been concerned by reports that AI chatbots can engage in alarming interactions with young users, as well as reports suggesting that companies offering generative AI companion chatbots might have been warned by their own employees that they were deploying the chatbots without doing enough to protect young users.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak

statements.text: Second, we must avoid slowing innovation in artificial intelligence thro ugh misguided enforcement actions. While the technology is still nascent, it is critically important to America’s economic and national security. The Commission needs to be circumspect when policing AI. Our focus should be on stopping fraudulent conduct and developing further our understanding of this industry, not seeking to stretch our statutory authorities.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: We have a vested interest in keeping America first when it comes to AI technology. With that in mind, the Commission s hould be looking for ways to pr omote dynamic competition and innovation in AI, not hamper it by pursuing unclear regulations or misguided enforcement actions.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: It is important that the Commission facilita te—not stymie—this upcoming growth of AI and innovation in the AI industry generally.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: The Commission plays an important role in ensuring that AI development is done in a manner that promotes competition, avoids entrenching dominant large technology companies, and mitigates fraudulent practices in the AI ecosystem.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: the Commission put a stop to AI-related law violations, such as deceiving consumers about what an AI lawyer service was capable of doing and what earnings AI-powered e-commerce stores could offer.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak

statements.text: This led to innovative solutions—including using AI technologies itself—to address the emerging threats that voice cloning poses to consumers and honest business.

attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: Part of the Commission’s investigations could also include investigating ways that trust and safety professionals may be collaboratively seeking to affect how AI is developed to moderate content.

statements.text: Accordingly, President Trump declared in January 2025 that it is United States policy to sustain and enhance the United States’ global AI dominance and ordered development of an AI action plan.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: The resulting America’s AI Action Plan issued in July 2025 calls for the United States to innovate faster and more comprehensively than our competitors in the development and distribution of new AI technology and to dismantle unnecessary regulatory barriers.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: Consistent with that plan, we at the Federal Trade Commission are committed to giving AI the ability to develop and reach its potential.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: At the same time, when it comes to AI, the Commission will work to meet our mandate to ensure competitive markets and protect consumers from fraudulent and other unlawful conduct.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: Artificial Intelligence has potential to benefit consumers and make American businesses more effective.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: Because FTC enforcement decisions affect market conduct and incentives, and ultimately consumers, we should act circumspectly to keep America first when it comes to AI.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: To help achieve that goal, we can use our authority to better understand evolving AI markets.

attribution.speaker: Melissa Holyoak
attribution.note: Automated extraction; exact quote and attribution span matched the retrieved source.

statements.text: And the United States has been at the forefront of developing AI, thanks to our business environment.
